baseline.largestMismatch: Lava reads as flat un-tonemapped salmon/orange paint with regular hot strips rather than a material carrying cooled crust, moving molten mass and localized heat response.

changes: Replaced regular authored lava bands with gravity-aware domain-warped macro, meso and micro advection.
Separated dark cooled crust rafts, deep molten body, orange openings, narrow yellow fissures and sparse white-hot cores.
Added view-dependent Fresnel and roughness-weighted glints to stop the lava reading as a flat emissive decal.
Moved authored and sea shaders through renderer tone mapping and output color conversion.
Replaced the unlit MeshBasicMaterial hot-core strip with a lit, tone-mapped MeshStandardMaterial.
Increased only localized canal heat-light response and slowed its thermal breathing.

performanceDelta.note: The shader does more fragment work; fresh runtime FPS evidence is still required.

runtimeEvidence.reason: The automated local-browser capture did not reach its evidence write, and the in-app browser declined further localhost automation. No visual score is recorded from code inspection.

decision.nextAction: Capture the exact overview, survey and left/right orbit views, inspect the least flattering lava contact first, then either record one bounded correction or approve.
